sections.care_plan: Care plan: Nursing problem: deficient fluid volume. Goal: Dehydration and hyperglycemia are corrected and glucose and electrolytes are stable. Observation: Measure I/O hourly and check glucose and serum K every 1-2 hours; Observe mental status and Kussmaul respiration continuously. Care: Coordinate IV rate titration with the physician; Look for an infection source (urine / lower respiratory tract) and record the temperature trend. Education: Explain hypo- and hyperglycemia symptoms and ask the patient to report feeling unwell early. Comorbidity and risk measures: glucose monitoring; hypoglycemia surveillance.
